title: The Apartment
synopsis: An office worker, a key lent to bosses, a sad elevator girl, and a New Year's Eve that finally chooses a person.

nodes.text: Locked out of your own apartment by Mr. Kirkeby and a date.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Wait under the awning.” The story records the instinct as “Polite” and carries it forward.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Bold.

nodes.text: Cards keep falling. Neither of you says it for a year. By then you don't need to. The neighbors approve. The neighbors had a betting pool.
You walk into an office across town with a small reference letter and a lighter shoulder, and you build a life that doesn't require a key to anyone else's place.
She opens a small place on a side street. You bus the tables on weekends. The strainer hangs above the counter like a chandelier.
